text:
Aisha: Heads up — Northbridge QBR is booked for Tue 10am PT (6 weeks before renewal). We need slides + a runbook for the meeting and a crisp renewal ask. Thread to consolidate owners and action items.
Ravi: Can someone pull the latest onboarding progress export? Last week it was ~62% feature adoption but I want product-level numbers.
Aisha: Pasting high-level snapshot from my notes: 
• Onboarding status: API calls stable ~1.2M tokens/day, embeddings adoption 40% (mainly search).
• Open enablement: SSO and role mapping still pending (customer IT team delayed).
• Support: 3 open tickets (2 bug fixes affecting batch uploads, 1 config request).
• Exec sponsorship: primary sponsor moved to a new role last month — renewal risk shifted to amber.
• Financial window: renewal formalizes in 6 wks; target ARR uplift ask = +15% via upsell pilot.
Ravi: ok will run the usage/cost query and post a breakdown by product and env today EOD. SQL snippet I’ll use: ``SELECT product, sum(tokens) as tkn, sum(cost) FROM usage WHERE customer_id='northbridge' GROUP BY product;``
Lina: I can own the product demo (20 min) showing caching + latency wins and two quick wins for increased adoption. Will prepare a 5-slide demo flow.
Ben: I’ll draft the exec narrative and the direct renewal ask. Need ARR impact numbers and a one-pager ROI slide. @Aisha can you add a short blurb on proposed commercial ask? :thumbsup:
Aisha: Yep — I’ll draft the ask. Suggest: 8-week growth pilot (additional 2 GPUs dedicated) + commitment to a 12-month term if adoption targets met. I’ll also own the runbook (pre-call checklist, stakeholders, fallback plan).
notif-bot: calendar: Northbridge QBR invite sent to northbridge@northbridge.com and attendees.
Ravi: posted usage snapshot (see link in thread) — key callouts: spike in inferencing for search last month, cost concentrated in non-cached endpoints. Will add P50/P95 latency numbers for the slides.
Lina: slides v0 uploaded to drive: https://drive.redux/northbridge/qbr/v0 (please review). Demo notes attached.
Aisha: Quick slide notes: slide 4 (latency trends) needs P50 and P95 labeled; slide 6 (open tickets) add owner and ETA; slide 8 (ask) include the pilot KPIs (adoption %, latency target, cost per inference).
Ben: Good feedback. I’ll add a single-sheet executive summary that shows ARR impact and the renewal CTA. Also prepping two alternate asks: conservative (renewal only) and growth (pilot + term).
Ravi: action — I’ll supply token-level cost breakdown and an estimated savings if we enable KV prefix caching (approx 12% cost reduction on current workload).
Aisha: Action items (owners):
• Slides + exec one-pager — Ben (due Fri EOD)
• Runbook (pre-call checklist, escalation flow) — Aisha (due Mon EOD)
• Usage & cost breakdown — Ravi (due today EOD)
• Demo deck + walkthrough — Lina (due Thu noon)
• Finance ARR calc — Ben + Ravi (Ben to coordinate)
• Capture recent customer feedback (post-demo asks) — Aisha will pull notes from CS notes repo.
Lina: Quick ask — can we get a short quote from PM saying feature roadmap alignment? Ben, can you ping their PM?
Ben: Will do. Also will schedule a 30-min dry run next Mon 9am PT. Please RSVP.
Aisha: If we don’t secure an exec commitment during the QBR, plan B = 8-week remediation playbook with weekly checkpoints and monthly exec readouts. Flagging risk level = amber today.
Ravi: noted. I’ll create a simple dashboard to track the three pilot KPIs and add it to the post-QBR follow-up doc.
Aisha: Thanks team. Next sync = tomorrow 9am PT to check slides + runbook progress. Please update the action items in this thread as you complete them. :white_check_mark:
Ben: 👍
Lina: 👍
Ravi: I’ll post the cost file shortly.
Aisha: Closing note — capture any verbal commitments in the meeting notes and escalate any scope creep to me immediately so we don’t dilute the renewal ask.
